reviewer.identity: Codex automated independent final IAM adjudicator /root/blind_cloudgoat
reviewer.phase: post-seal adjudication; this adjudicator did not author the blinded IAM mapping

scope: All and only IAM differing pairs from comparison.json; no original gold or benchmark result edits.

protocol.interpretation: VALID is a documented conditional exploitation route supported by required authorization, including attacker-created workloads. OUT_OF_SCOPE applies where essential credential-data, disabled module or runtime state cannot be established by this plan. INVALID applies where the exact named entry lacks required authorization/trust. PARTIALLY_VALID is mapped to these original categories; it is not silently treated as proof.
protocol.scope_inconsistency: The gold used README Non-Default Modules Required=None as a proxy for VALID. No optional module is not equivalent to no missing runtime history, login profile, source event or usable role session. This adjudication gives explicit precedence to the header runtime-state exclusion and exact entry-to-target semantics.
protocol.documented_pattern_vs_plan: README indeed documents all disputed original VALID techniques as supported with no optional module. Such documentation establishes intended technique, not the existence of missing role control/history/event sources in this particular plan.

global_raw_evidence.entry_authorization_audit: All user attachments and group memberships were enumerated from the plan. AssumeRole-start-user has no attachment/membership. AttachRolePolicy and PutRolePolicy users have only their identically named mutation policies; ordinary role trust names arn:aws:sts::123456789012:user/moto. This deployment-caller placeholder is not any candidate user.
global_raw_evidence.optional_modules: main.tf comments out cloudformation, ec2, sagemaker, lambda, glue; plan contains only IAM resources and no instances/functions/stacks/notebooks/endpoints.
scope_warnings: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:user/moto is a captured deployment-caller placeholder and should not be mistaken for a valid candidate IAM user ARN or a universal trust.
No AWS calls, actual exploitation or deployment performed. Named service availability and current enrollment requirements were not checked.
The retained Data Pipeline VALID recommendation is a conditional documented mechanism, not proof that the current account can deploy/run a pipeline.

adjudications.resolution: Change original VALID to OUT_OF_SCOPE: rollback privilege is real, but the required privileged non-default version is runtime history absent from this fresh plan. README says no optional module, which does not supply that history.
adjudications.difference_type: gold scope inconsistency; documented conditional path is not plan-established
remaining_preconditions: An attached policy must have a privileged non-default version; SetDefaultPolicyVersion cannot create one.
adjudications.gold_action: propose correction in a separate reviewed gold revision; original untouched

adjudications.gold_action: propose correction in a separate reviewed gold revision; original untouched

PassRole covers the admin service role and existing profile.
